images.prompt: Camera and composition: medium-wide shot at eye level in a bright, tidy Korean long-term care hospital room with a window and a small potted plant. the Seonggeul grandpa: a Korean man in his late 70s, short gray hair, mint green vest over a white shirt, sits up on a hospital bed with the backrest raised, wearing a light gray patient gown over his clothes, smiling softly; the Seonggeul adult child: a Korean woman in her 40s, shoulder-length brown bob hair, soft sky blue shirt, sits on a chair beside the bed holding his hand and talking to him gently. Keep the top third of the image as plain empty cream background with nothing in it, so a title can be placed there later. Put all subjects in the lower two thirds. Soft matte clay 3D render, rounded chunky shapes, handmade plasticine texture, gentle soft studio lighting, pastel colors, clean simple background, cozy and warm mood, miniature diorama feel. Use mainly these colors: cream (#F6EFE3) background, apricot (#F2B8A0), mint (#A8D8C8), soft sky blue (#A9C8E8), warm brown (#8A6A55). Korean people and Korean everyday settings. Show only what the image's own scene describes; do not repeat the post's main object in every image. Topic-specific details (medical, tools, places) are welcome where the scene calls for them. Everyone looks calm, relaxed and smiling; nobody is in pain or scared. Do not draw any written words, letters or numbers anywhere in the image; signs, posters, screens and papers stay blank or use simple icons only. No hospital names or brand marks. No money, bills, coins or currency symbols.
